item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.1:
Tokimi's Toolshed

Tool Manual

A reference for every tool in this mod. Turn pages with the arrows at the bottom.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.2:
%s Excavator

Breaks a 3x3 area of shovel-friendly blocks in one swing. Aim at the center block. Sneak while mining to break only that one block.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.3:
%s Hammer

Breaks a 3x3 area of pickaxe-friendly blocks in one swing. Aim at the center block. Sneak to break only that block.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.4:
%s Scythe

Breaks a 3x3 area of crops, saplings, or short plants at once. Also works as a hoe on soil. Sneak to disable the area effect.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.5:
%s Lumber Axe

Fells an entire tree in one swing. Aim at any log of the tree. Sneak to chop only a single log. Works up to 256 logs per tree.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.6:
%s Clippers

Acts like shears but affects a 3x3 area. Use on leaves, wool, cobwebs, or any block shears can cut. Sneak to shear one block.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.7:
%s Iron Chisel
%s Diamond Chisel

Replaces a block you right-click with one from your inventory. Iron works on iron-tier blocks and below. Diamond works on everything. Repair in an anvil with iron ingots or diamonds. They wear out but do not break.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.8:
%s Chisel Modes

Copy Mode: uses the block in your off-hand.

Shuffle Mode: uses a random block from your hotbar.

Hold Left Alt and scroll the mouse wheel to switch modes.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.9:
%s Silk Touch

Without an enchantment, a chisel drops what breaking the block normally would. Apply Silk Touch on an anvil to keep the original block instead.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.10:
%s Trowel

Places a random block from your hotbar when you right-click. Skips empty slots and the trowel itself. Useful for scattering variants across a build.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.11:
%s Abacus

Right-click a block to mark it. Right-click a second block to see the distance from the mark. A HUD readout appears while holding the abacus. Right-click the marked block again to unbind.
item.tokimistoolshed.manual.page.12:
%s Copper Bucket

Works like an iron bucket for water, lava, powder snow, and milk. Wears out after 16 uses instead of lasting forever.
